description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring Boot REST controller named ItemController, which handles CRUD operations related to items in a billing software. It exposes endpoints for adding, reading, and removing items, and interacts with the ItemService for business logic.

classes.name: ItemController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller managing item-related endpoints, including adding, fetching, and deleting items.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new item, including parsing JSON from request part and processing a file upload.

methods.name: readItems
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch the list of all items.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an item by ID, throws exception if item not found.
